description: This file contains implementation of numeric utility functions for digit, hex, base64 conversions, and the definition of the Fractional class with its methods.

classes.name: Fractional
classes.description: A class representing a fractional number with integer and remainder parts, including constructors, destructor, and assignment operator.

methods.name: FromDigits
methods.description: Converts a character digit to its numeric value, returns 0 if not a digit.

methods.name: FromHexDigits
methods.description: Converts a hexadecimal character to its numeric value, returns 0 if not a valid hex digit.

methods.name: FromBase64
methods.description: Converts a base64 character to its numeric value, returns 0 if not a valid base64 character.

methods.name: FromDirect
methods.description: Returns the unsigned char value of the character.

methods.name: ToDigits
methods.description: Converts a numeric value to its character digit representation.

methods.name: ToHexDigits
methods.description: Converts a numeric value to its hexadecimal character representation.

methods.name: ToBase64
methods.description: Converts a numeric value to its base64 character representation.

methods.name: ToDirect
methods.description: Returns the character representation of an unsigned char.

methods.name: Fractional
methods.description: A class representing fractional numbers with integer and remainder parts.
